verdicts.reason: A shrinks the circles back inside the canvas so the GLACIER wordmark and the top of the can sit on the big teal circle, which breaks the clean backdrop the original had. A also leaves a large empty band at the top and a dead zone under the legal line, and the legal line floats mid-canvas over the light-blue circle. B keeps the original structure: the circles bleed off the corners, the logo sits on clean background, the can is a good size, the spacing from headline to CTA to legal is even, and the legal line is anchored at the bottom. B's only flaw is legal text that is tiny at this size, and A has the same problem.
